negative_results.claim: Universal global epoch lock is the default consistency mechanism.
negative_results.reason: Synthetic basis test showed substantial harmless rejection under unrelated churn; operation-specific dependencies remain the preferred OPEN candidate.

negative_results.claim: Record provenance/authenticity is sufficient memory security.
negative_results.reason: Constructed selection redirection keeps records authentic; independent arXiv:2606.12290 reports the same mechanism class.

negative_results.claim: Exact-anchor validation of returned records is sufficient to secure retrieval.
negative_results.reason: It cannot prove omitted or redirected candidate membership when returned records remain authentic.

negative_results.claim: Projection hash/schema identity proves semantic projection correctness.
negative_results.reason: Identity does not validate compiler semantics; reference/differential/mutation checks remain necessary.

negative_results.claim: In-place mutation should be the default reader-visible derived epoch publication model.
negative_results.reason: Old-or-new immutable publication has the clearer replay/concurrency contract; real crash stress remains open.

negative_results.claim: Every sparse semantic revocation requires full latent-field rebase.
negative_results.reason: Direct dependency-scoped invalidation was much cheaper in the synthetic reference test; transitive completeness remains open.

negative_results.claim: Bundled GWT on/off contrast is a causal workspace estimator when adjacent stages change.
negative_results.reason: Four-factor synthetic calibration showed bundled contrast can be many times larger than the planted direct workspace effect.

negative_results.claim: One unconstrained soft scalar is sufficient for runtime governor choice.
negative_results.reason: Synthetic search selected a security-tripwire-violating configuration despite feasible constrained alternatives.

negative_results.claim: Selection Integrity is globally novel to RAE/Clay G9.
negative_results.reason: Prior June-2026 external literature (arXiv:2606.12290) already formalized and tested the mechanism. RAE contribution is independent convergence/application, not global novelty.

negative_results.claim: Functional integration, recurrence, GWT structure or self-reference alone justify phenomenal-consciousness inference.
negative_results.reason: Current Emergence Certificate requires prospective prediction, lesion, rescue, OOD and multiscale causal evidence and still does not establish phenomenal consciousness.
